words.sentence: The winner got a gold medal.
words.def: This yellow metal is very expensive.

words.sentence: Grandma has got a silver ring.
words.def: This grey metal is shiny. The second medal is made of it.

words.sentence: I wrote a letter on a piece of paper.
words.def: Books and magazines are made of this. You can write on it.
Spoons, cars and keys are often made of this. It is hard and strong.

words.sentence: This cup is made of plastic.
words.def: Lots of toys and bottles are made of this.

words.sentence: Be careful! The glass can break.
words.def: You can see through this. Windows are made of it.
